contentText: In tonight's edition, Human Rights Watch says Burkina Faso’s government forces and jihadists together killed more than 1800 civilians between 2023 and 2025. Also, a collapsed, unfinished school in Accra kills four people and injures nearly 30, raising concerns over unsafe classrooms. And  Belgium is resisting a U.S.-backed AI firm’s attempt to access historic mining maps that could reveal valuable mineral deposits.
